messages:
sara_ng: Heads-up: rolled FP8 mixed-precision runtime to a small L40S pool. Seeing intermittent p99 spikes (~2.5x) when KV cache warms and the kernel selector flips between TE-FP8 and INT8 paths. Dumping profiler traces here.

miguel_r: Can you paste the exact transformer-engine flags and kernel selector overrides you used?

sara_ng: Sure — config I launched the canary with:
```
--te-quant-mode=fp8
--kernel-selector=auto
--int8-fallback=enabled
--kv-warmup=enabled
--kv-warmup-prefixes=4
--batching-microbatch-max=4
--kernel-lock-policy=off
```

kevin_w: Thanks. Any runtime logs or a short trace of the switch?

sara_ng: Short extract from the runtime log around the spike:
```
[14:12:03] model=x-13b node=l40s-7 kernel_switch: chosen=te_fp8 previous=int8 reason=kv_miss_rate>0.25
[14:12:03] model=x-13b kv_miss_rate=0.31 kv_fill_size=64 latency_ms=12.6
[14:12:03] batch_size=3 microbatch=1 p99_ms=128   <-- spike
[14:12:04] kernel_switch: chosen=int8 previous=te_fp8 fallback=slow_path
```

nora_ops: Is this happening on H100 as well or only L40S?

sara_ng: Only L40S so far. Replayed the same request shapes on a small H100 pool and didn't observe the p99 spike. My current hypothesis: the transformer-engine FP8 handshake on L40S is introducing a micro-scheduling stall when the KV fill hits and we switch kernels mid-request.

miguel_r: Ran a quick perf stat on one repro run — shows higher warp stalls and memory contention when kernel_switch occurs:
```
GPU busy: 92%
warp_stalls: 28%
memory_stalls: 46%
wavefront_restarts: 12
```

kevin_w: Possible mitigations: 1) avoid kernel switching mid-request by pinning kernel selection until kv_hit_ratio > 0.8; 2) ensure prefix warmup to populate KV cache ahead of serving; 3) prevent microbatch reduction when switching kernels (the batching heuristic seems to shrink to microbatch=1 when it detects a slower path).

sara_ng: I'll spin a canary with kernel_lock enabled and prefix_warmup=4, and also log batching decisions. Noticed the batching heuristic shrinks microbatch from 4->1 right when the switch happens which amplifies overhead.

perf-bot: deploy Canary(canary-23) started: 4 L40S nodes with kernel_lock=fp8-prefer; prefix_warmup=4; metrics will post to /metrics/fp8_canary_23

nora_ops: If mitigation looks good, add telemetry: kernel_switch_count per model, kv_hit_ratio tags on p99 metrics, and alert if switch_count>3 within 5m.

miguel_r: Two follow-ups from my side: 1) add a kernel-lock rollout stage in orchestrator with a 10m grace period to avoid mid-flight switches; 2) revisit TE L40S nvcc compile flags — try tuning register pressure/occupancy (e.g., reduce maxrregcount) to see if it reduces warp stalls. I'll open PRs for both.

kevin_w: :thumbsup: keep us posted.

sara_ng: Will upload full traces to the perf bucket after the canary stabilizes: gs://redwood-inference/perf/fp8-l40s/2951234567/trace.pbz

miguel_r: Also worth adding an automated microbenchmark that toggles kernel-selector under load with KV fill patterns to catch this in CI.

sara_ng: Agreed — adding that to the perf regression checklist. Thanks all.
